attchmntText: Sonaselection India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sonaselection India Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the Financial Express and Nafa Nuksan newspapers on 15th November 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 14th November 2026. Satyam MicroCapital Limited reported a net loss of 8,506.49 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. QMS Medical Allied Services Limited reported a net loss of 8,506.49 lakhs for the same period. KNR Constructions Limited reported a net profit of 28,076.27 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. McLeod Russel India Limited reported a net profit of 28,076.27 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Sonaselection India Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of IPO proceeds aggregating to Rs.141.57 crore. The report, issued by CARE Ratings Limited, notes a deviation of 10 to 15 percent in the object for repayment of borrowings. The company utilized Rs.85.16 crore against a proposed Rs.80.00 crore, resulting in an unutilized balance of Rs.5.16 crore, which falls within the permissible 10 percent threshold. Unutilized proceeds of Rs.15.45 crore are held as credit balances in cash credit accounts with State Bank of India and HDFC Bank. Additionally, Rs.30.00 crore is parked in fixed deposits with State Bank of India. No funds were utilized for capital expenditure during the quarter. The Audit Committee has reviewed the report.

attchmntText: Sonaselection India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sonaselection India Limited Board approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 14 November 2026. Revenue from operations was 155.21 crore for the quarter and 300.96 crore for the half year. Profit after tax stood at 12.72 crore for the quarter and 22.37 crore for the half year. Basic earnings per share was 2.96 for the quarter and 5.24 for the half year. Total assets were 602.76 crore as of 30 September 2026. The statutory auditors, Pokharna Somani and Associates, issued a review report stating no material misstatements were identified.
